# Tracker Update

Use this packet for one native tracker comment or status note. Replace every placeholder and report only observed evidence. Write the comment for people, as the project-management skill's record-writing reference describes: one to three plain lines first, with no headings, and leave out any part with nothing to say. When a person needs to act, the summary says so; the next-step line only adds detail. The native reference and status intent route the update; they are never written into the comment. Detail only agents need, such as commands, output, and commit identities, goes after a divider in collapsed agent notes.

When relevant, the summary names the operator journey now possible, the evidence names the real use and safety proof behind it, and the next step names the learning sought or the breadth still deferred.
